lines:
Root cause: the presentation treated the saved-workflow library as mount-local state.
- The editor never republished the library projection after an accepted document save, so a changed workflow name stayed invisible in its own dropdown.
- A library rename rewrote the stored document while the open editor kept its older copy; the editor therefore showed the previous name and wrote it back on the next save.
- ChatWorkspaceScreen read the saved-workflow library once on mount while the app keeps routed surfaces mounted, so a workflow created or renamed afterwards never appeared in the composer's Workflow dropdown and could not be selected.

Changes:
- WorkflowEditorScreen: republish the library (and notify other surfaces) after an accepted document save; after a library rename adopt the renamed stored document as the new save base; if the editor holds unsaved edits, keep the draft untouched, adopt the renamed document version, align the draft name and report it with a notice; open a created workflow even when the follow-up library read fails.
- ChatWorkspaceScreen: re-read the saved-workflow library whenever the surface becomes active or the library revision changes; keep the last known entries when a reload fails; fall back to the stored default when the selected workflow no longer exists.
- ChatComposer: repair an empty workflow selection once a library default is known, so an unlocked composer is never left unable to send.
- App: owns the library-revision refresh signal passed to both surfaces.

Audit result (task.end hook): the first implementation discarded unsaved editor edits when a rename landed while the draft was dirty. That gap was found in review, fixed, and covered by a new test; the audit is now clean.

Evidence:
- tsc --noEmit clean.
- New tests desktop/src/workbench/workflowLibraryProjection.test.tsx (3: create/rename/save label, rename with unsaved edits, accepted-write with failed reread) and desktop/src/chat/workflowLibraryRefresh.test.tsx (3: re-entry list refresh and selectability, revision-driven refresh, failure keeps the last list). Verified failing on the unmodified editor/chat sources.
- Suites: chat + workbench workflow/library/contract + nativeMenuTypography 141 passed; workbench 175 passed; notifications/management/shell/protocol/commandId/settings-v2 75 passed; all 9 app.integration cases pass individually.

Pre-existing, unrelated and untouched: domain/css chatLoading.css .inspector-window-note uses a fixed font-size and fails systemTextScale.test.ts; whole-file runs of app.integration.test.tsx and workbench/SettingsScreen.test.tsx stall in this environment (they also stall without these changes), so those files were run per test case.

Verification limit: the Rust crate cannot be compiled here (MSVC cl.exe D8050, link.exe not found on the default PATH), so native workflow_create/workflow_rename behaviour was verified by reading desktop/src-tauri/src/runtime/documents.rs, runtime/service.rs and runtime/dto.rs; it derives each library entry name from the stored document, which is what the fixed UI now relies on.

Reported defects:
1. The workflow editor's saved-workflow dropdown kept the previous label after the stored workflow document name changed, because Save never republished the library projection.
2. A rename through the library strip left the open editor document stale, so the editor kept showing (and could later save) the previous name over the renamed stored document.
3. A workflow created or renamed in the editor never appeared in the Chat composer's Workflow dropdown, because ChatWorkspaceScreen read the saved-workflow library once when it mounted and the app keeps routed surfaces mounted.

Fixes (frontend only; the trusted core already derives each entry name from the stored document):
- WorkflowEditorScreen: republish the library after an accepted document save; adopt the renamed stored document after a library rename (explicit notice when unsaved edits were replaced); open a created workflow even when the follow-up library read fails.
- ChatWorkspaceScreen: re-read the saved-workflow library whenever the surface becomes active or a library revision changes; keep the last known entries when a reload fails; fall back to the stored default when the selected workflow no longer exists.
- ChatComposer: repair an empty workflow selection once a library default is known, so an unlocked composer is never left unable to send.
- App: own a library-revision refresh signal passed to both surfaces.

Regression tests: desktop/src/workbench/workflowLibraryProjection.test.tsx (one native-shaped document store behind both ports) and desktop/src/chat/workflowLibraryRefresh.test.tsx. All five fail without the fixes.

Verification limits: the Rust crate cannot be built in this environment (MSVC cl.exe D8050 / link.exe), so native workflow_create/rename persistence was verified by reading runtime/documents.rs and service.rs, not by running native tests.

data.title: Fix saved-workflow library staleness: renamed and newly created workflows missing from the editor and Chat dropdowns
